About RevOpHubs

A public RevOps initiative by SmartLinks.

RevOpHubs organises practical Revenue Operations knowledge, tools and field observations. It is created and maintained by SmartLinks, a B2B growth consultancy in Portugal.

01 / Relationship

Part of SmartLinks, with a clear point of view.

The publication reflects the systems, questions and tools encountered in SmartLinks work across marketing, sales, CRM, automation, data and AI.

RevOpHubs is not presented as an independent third-party directory. Vendor profiles and frameworks combine official documentation with the operating perspective developed through SmartLinks practice. External sources are identified where relevant.

What belongs here

The site separates useful education from a generic list of software.

Knowledge

Clear RevOps foundations

Definitions, history and practical models for connecting the revenue system.

Practice

Field-informed guidance

Lessons and patterns drawn from the problems SmartLinks helps B2B organisations solve.

Tools

Operational fit, not feature volume

Technology is evaluated by its role, prerequisites, integration and governance requirements.
